title: One Docker image can be enough

slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: One Docker image can be enough
slides.subtitle: For a small agent app, keep deployment simple.

slides.title: Small app, simple deploy
slides.body: A FastAPI backend and a small JavaScript frontend do not always need separate services.

slides.title: Use a multi-stage build
slides.body: Build the frontend in a Node.js stage, then copy the generated static files into the backend image.

slides.title: Keep runtime lean
slides.body: The final container serves the API and frontend assets without carrying Node.js dependencies into production.

slides.title: Still test inside Docker
slides.body: The demo caught an API key issue only after running the app inside the container.
